title: Leah Martel confronts internal battles with new single “What Doesn’t Make Me Stronger”
htmlContent: In her new single, "What Doesn't Make Me Stronger," Leah Martel shares her honest thoughts on the lasting effects of difficult experiences, even when the worst seems to be behind us. At a time when everything in her life looked perfect, a new job, a new relationship, and fresh starts, Martel found herself dealing with feelings she couldn't quite shake. This song captures the unsettling truth that even when life becomes calmer, the past can still echo in our hearts. Her voice conveys a quiet intensity, both soft and strong, as it flows along with the music that reflects her emotional journey. The arrangement blends a sense of sadness with a determined spirit, highlighting that healing is rarely a straight path. The melody shifts like the ups and downs of her feelings, each note representing the struggle of moving forward while still carrying the weight of what's been left behind. https://open.spotify.com/track/7kZeC5mXjQttENXzarNaf5?si=UxzaG_1DQmOkEM4VK0uGOA "What Doesn't Make Me Stronger" recognizes that healing is about overcoming pain and learning to live with it. Martel may not have all the solutions, but she is determined to keep going, even when the future feels uncertain. This song resonates with anyone who has dealt with unseen wounds, reminding them that strength is the bravery to seek hope and light, even when darkness feels familiar.
